text: Rowan. Blacksmith. What do you need?

choices.label: Bind the item in my hand to my soul.

text: A bound item crosses between worlds with you, and you keep it when you die.
It doesn't lock it to you. You can still drop it, and anyone who picks it up can use it. And it can't be undone.
One more of the same thing, so I've something to work into it. Or a spare fragment from one of the four worlds; you keep the other.
No coins. I've no use for them.
